description.zh:
选题热点要分析的类型（多选，不传默认分析全部。 传空数组，默认不做选题热点分析，仅聚类。）
HotViewPoints： 热门选题视角分析
WebReviewPoints： 网友选题视角分析（需要有评论）
TimedViewPoints：时效性选题视角分析
FreshViewPoints：新颖视角分析
TopicSummary：新闻摘要分析
description.en:
The types of analysis for hot topic selection. Multiple values are supported. If you omit this parameter, the service analyzes all types by default. If you pass an empty array, the service performs only clustering and skips the analysis of hot topics for selection.
`HotViewPoints`: Analyzes perspectives on hot topics.
`WebReviewPoints`: Analyzes user viewpoints. This requires comments.
`TimedViewPoints`: Analyzes perspectives on timeliness.
`FreshViewPoints`: Analyzes novel perspectives.
`TopicSummary`: Summarizes news content.

description.zh: 文件类型（json: json数组格式，jsonLine：json行格式）
description.en: The file type. Valid values: `json` (JSON array) and `jsonLine` (JSON Lines).

description.zh: 文件URL（FileUrl与News二选一）（文件的结构请参考 News字段）
description.en: The file URL. You must specify either `FileUrl` or `News`. For details on the file structure, see the description of the `News` parameter.

description.zh: 最大分析的话题数量（默认情况下 会按照聚类后的新闻数量倒排，取TOP50 进行话题分析，最大200条 ）
description.en: The maximum number of topics to analyze. By default, the service sorts clustered news by count in descending order and analyzes the top 50 topics. The maximum value is 200.
A list of news articles. You must specify either `News` or `FileUrl`.
The content of the news article.

description.zh: 发布时间(格式为： YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)
description.en: The publication time. The format must be `YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`.
The source of the news article.
The title of the news article.
The URL of the news article.

description.zh: 自定义字段，后续可以根据 ListHotTopics 接口使用该字段筛选。
description.en: A custom field. You can use this field to filter results when you call the `ListHotTopics` operation.

description.zh: 话题URL，无其他作用，仅供 ListHotTopics透传作用
description.en: The URL of the topic. This value is passed through to the `ListHotTopics` response without being processed.

description.zh: 话题列表URL(使用 json line 格式，每行是一个json)
description.en: The URL of the file that contains the topic list. The file must be in JSON Lines format, with each line representing a single JSON object.

title.zh: 提交自定义源话题选题分析任务
title.en: Submit a topic selection analysis job from a Custom source
